name: HTMLViewer
description: The `HTMLViewer.vue` component includes zoom in and zoom out functionalities using Font Awesome icons to enhance the interface. It consists of an `iframe` displaying HTML content and a `Code` component for previewing the HTML in code format. The component manages a zoom level with methods to increase or decrease it within set boundaries. The configuration ensures a default HTML content if none is provided. The design improvements focus on providing a modern and visually appealing user interface.
